info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Loyalty memberships API

items.docs: Returns all loyalty memberships of the enterprise, optionally filtered by specific loyalty membership identifiers, activity states, or other filter parameters. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Adds loyalty memberships to the enterprise. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Updates information about the specified loyalty memberships. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
Deletes loyalty memberships. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
